criteria.name: Footprint and clearance
criteria.description: How much room the robot and its dock take. Robot height: up to 3.25 in = 5, up to 3.6 in = 4, up to 3.9 in = 3, up to 4.2 in = 2, taller = 1. Dock floor area (width × depth): up to 40 sq in = 5, up to 110 = 4, up to 200 = 3, up to 300 = 2, larger = 1. The score is the sum of both, from the maker's published dimensions or an independent measurement.

criteria.name: Cleaning performance
criteria.description: Pickup on hard floors, carpet and hair in independent tests. 9–10: top results on all three. 7–8: strong on hard floors, good on carpet, one clear weakness. 5–6: good on hard floors, clear weaknesses on carpet or hair. 4 or less: struggles broadly.

criteria.name: Navigation in tight spaces
criteria.description: Mapping and obstacle avoidance in independent tests, which matter most in small, cluttered rooms. 9–10: avoids nearly every test obstacle. 7–8: good avoidance with occasional misses. 5–6: accurate maps but weak or patchy obstacle avoidance. 4 or less: unreliable mapping or frequently stuck.
